title: Add GET /api/codex/ping endpoint with response time field
description: Add `GET /api/codex/ping` to the FastAPI backend. The response must be a JSON object with three fields: `pong` (boolean, always true), `ts` (Unix epoch seconds as a float, captured server-side at handler entry), and `latency_ms` (the wall-clock millisecond duration between handler entry and response serialization). The endpoint must require no request body and no query parameters.
acceptance_criteria: Response includes pong=true, ts (float), and latency_ms (number) fields
latency_ms is non-negative and reflects handler duration

argv: import time; from fastapi import FastAPI; from fastapi.testclient import TestClient; from app.interfaces.api import router; app = FastAPI(); app.include_router(router); t0 = time.time(); r = TestClient(app).get('/api/codex/ping'); body = r.json(); assert r.status_code == 200; assert body['pong'] is True; assert isinstance(body['ts'], (int, float)); assert abs(body['ts'] - t0) < 5.0; assert isinstance(body['latency_ms'], (int, float)) and body['latency_ms'] >= 0
pinned_qa_commands.description: Fetch /api/codex/ping and assert pong, ts, latency_ms

notes: latency_ms must be computed inside the handler so the field is meaningful.
